title: Sharplink news
description: A latest-articles section on the dotted three-column grid: label and big title on the left, a tinted button on the right, then square-cornered article cards (16:9 image with a tiny blue corner square, outlined tag and date chips, title, small arrow box). On hover a card gains a hairline outline, its image zooms to 108% and its arrow box turns blue. On phones the cards become a swipe track with previous / next boxes.
notes: images are slots; empty, each shows a black-to-glow gradient placeholder
the previous / next boxes (phones) need JavaScript (hydrate: visible); the track also swipes without it
transparent background: on the page it shows the Sharplink backdrop wash
